title: PDEA agents seize P1.7-M shabu, arrest suspect in Cotabato City

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — Authorities seized about P1.7 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested a suspected drug peddler during a joint buy-bust operation in Poblacion 5 here on Tuesday, Sept. 29. The operation was led by the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency–Maguindanao del Norte Provincial Office (PDEA-MagNor), according to PDEA-BARMM Regional Director George Paul Alcovindas. Joining the PDEA in the entrapment operation were operatives from Cotabato City Police Office, National Intelligence Coordinating Agency 17 (NICA 17), PNP Drug Enforcement Group–Special Operations Unit BAR (PDEG-SOU BAR).
